{{one source |date=April 2024}}
'''Constraint''' in [[information theory]] is the degree of statistical dependence between or among variables.

Garner<ref> Garner W R (1962). ''Uncertainty and Structure as Psychological Concepts'', John Wiley & Sons, New York.</ref> provides a thorough discussion of various forms of constraint (internal constraint, external constraint, total constraint) with application to [[pattern recognition]] and [[psychology]].
